items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I think the old two Happies was my favorite. Happy was favorite for that orchestra, that pit boy in the theater

ctx.x: Red Happy, Red Happy. Well I like Happy on the drum, but the brass band too. I think the old two Happies was my favorite. Happy was favorite for that orchestra, that pit boy in the theater, and Lil Black Happy on that street. He was a little, little son. He was a showman.
On the snare? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Did you listen to many bass drum players?
